{{recipesummary|category=Meat recipes|servings=6|time=2 hours 20 minutes|difficulty=2}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Meat Recipes|Meat Recipes]] | [[Cookbook:Midwestern cuisine|Midwestern U.S. cuisine]]

'''Six layer casserole''' is a great recipe for when friends are visiting. The preparation can all be done hours in advance.

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]]
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]] diced
*½ cup diced [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
*½ cup raw [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] [[Cookbook:Beef|ground beef]]
*10 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] canned [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]] soup (you may also use homemade tomato sauce)
*2 cups water
*[[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] and [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]

==Procedure==
# Spread layers of raw vegetables and rice in a 9x9-inch baking dish in the order mentioned above and crumble raw hamburger on the top.
# Mix the soup and water and pour over all.
# Add salt and pepper on top.
# Bake about 1.5–2 hours at 350°F.
==Notes, tips, and variations==
* After dishing some of the casserole to your plate, spread ketchup over the top. It may sound odd but it tastes great.
* If you double the recipe, use a tall 9x13-inch baking dish and bake it a little longer.
